title: CO2 hydrogenation to formate / formic acid reference family
reaction: CO2 + H2 -> HCOOH (homogeneous / heterogeneous) | CO2 + 2 e- + H+ -> HCOO- (electrochemical, see CO2RR family)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for CO2-to-formate (formic acid) catalysis. Candidates compare a homogeneous Ir-pincer benchmark (Tanaka/Nozaki 2009 anchor), a Ru pincer alternative (Sanford 2013), and a heterogeneous PdAg / N-doped carbon emerging route. Aqueous electrochemical reduction of CO2 to formate is covered separately by the CO2RR family.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported turnover / formate selectivity.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost (precious-metal exposure) while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and reproducible CO2-to-formate routes.

citations.label: J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2009
citations.note: Tanaka, Yamashita and Nozaki: catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 using Ir(III)-pincer complexes; foundational homogeneous catalyst (850+ citations) for CO2 to formate.

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2013
citations.note: Huff and Sanford: catalytic CO2 hydrogenation to formate by a ruthenium pincer complex, key benchmark for Ru-PNN/PNP pincer chemistry.

citations.label: Chem. Sci. 2013
citations.note: Kang and Meyer: selective electrocatalytic reduction of CO2 to formate by a water-soluble iridium pincer catalyst, bridging homogeneous and electrochemical formate production.

citations.label: Chem. Eng. J. 2016
citations.note: Zhao and Wang: electrochemical reduction of CO2 to formate in aqueous solution using electro-deposited Sn catalysts, key heterogeneous-electro reference for formate-selective CO2RR.

citations.label: Coord. Chem. Rev. 2018
citations.note: Onishi, Laurenczy et al.: foundational review of reversible homogeneous catalytic hydrogen storage in formic acid and methanol, framing CO2-to-formate within the H2-storage cycle.

citations.label: Chem 2019
citations.note: Shao and Yang: iridium single-atom catalyst performing a quasi-homogeneous hydrogenation transformation of CO2 to formate, bridging the homogeneous-heterogeneous boundary.

citations.label: Mol. Catal. 2019
citations.note: Zhang et al.: zirconia phase effect in Pd / ZrO2-catalysed CO2 hydrogenation into formate, supporting Pd-on-oxide screening for thermal-catalysis routes.

citations.label: Appl. Catal. B 2021
citations.note: Yang and Kuwahara: PdAg alloy nanoparticles encapsulated in N-doped microporous hollow carbon spheres for hydrogenation of CO2 to formate.

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2017
citations.note: Single-atomic Ru on Mg-Al layered double hydroxide: selective CO2-to-formic-acid at 100 C and 2 MPa in basic aqueous medium.

citations.label: Chem. Rev. 2015
citations.note: Authoritative review of CO2 hydrogenation to formate and methanol.

route_templates.name: Homogeneous Ir-pincer route
quality_gates: Turnover-number screen for CO2 to formate
route_templates.route_note: Homogeneous Ir-pincer route with the highest documented per-Ir turnovers; Ir economics dominate the cost basis. Small-scale step availability: filter_rotary_vacuum swapped for filter_plate_frame.

route_templates.name: Homogeneous Ru-pincer route
quality_gates: Turnover-number screen for CO2 to formate
route_templates.route_note: Ru-pincer alternative to the Ir baseline; Ru is meaningfully cheaper than Ir but turnover frequency is typically lower. Small-scale step availability: filter_rotary_vacuum swapped for filter_plate_frame.

route_templates.name: Heterogeneous PdAg / N-doped carbon route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Supported PdAg alloy on N-doped carbon
preprocess: N-doped carbon support synthesis or staging
synthesis: Sequential or co-impregnation of Pd and Ag
route_templates.route_note: Heterogeneous PdAg on N-doped carbon for CO2-to-formate; alloy and N-functionalisation control selectivity over CO byproduct. Small-scale step availability: filter_rotary_vacuum swapped for filter_plate_frame; kiln_continuous_indirect swapped for kiln_batch.

route_templates.name: LDH co-precipitation with Ru grafting
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Powder catalyst for aqueous batch service
preprocess: Mg/Al nitrate and carbonate-base solution make-up
synthesis: Co-precipitation of the layered double hydroxide
pH-controlled grafting of the Ru precursor onto surface hydroxyls
postprocess: Low-temperature drying preserving single-site Ru (no calcination to metal)
route_templates.route_note: Deliberately skips calcination to keep the ruthenium atomically dispersed; the grafting step rides on the multistep-reactor rate.

candidates.title: Ir-pincer (Tanaka / Nozaki anchor)
candidates.summary: Iridium-pincer homogeneous catalyst for CO2 hydrogenation to formate; the highest-turnover documented homogeneous benchmark.
decision_notes: Best fit when very high turnover frequency is the program goal and Ir economics are acceptable.
Iridium price exposure dominates the cost basis; ligand-only proxy understates total catalyst cost.

pricing.note: Live Ir feed with a precursor / conversion markup; pincer-ligand mass is included implicitly.
Pincer ligand cost held on a derived screening proxy reflecting multi-step organic-synthesis overhead.

candidates.title: Ru-pincer (Sanford / Beller-style)
candidates.summary: Ruthenium-pincer homogeneous catalyst for CO2 hydrogenation to formate, providing a lower precious-metal-cost alternative to the Ir benchmark.
decision_notes: Use when Ru chemistry is acceptable and cost reduction over Ir is desirable.
Pincer-ligand cost dominates total cost more than Ir route since Ru is cheaper per oz.

pricing.note: Live Ru feed with a precursor / conversion markup.
Pincer ligand cost held on the same derived screening proxy as the Ir route.

candidates.title: PdAg / N-doped carbon
candidates.summary: PdAg alloy nanoparticles encapsulated in N-doped microporous carbon for heterogeneous CO2-to-formate hydrogenation.
decision_notes: Best fit when a heterogeneous, separable catalyst is required and a small Pd / Ag inventory is acceptable.
N-doped carbon support supplies amine-style sites that stabilise CO2 / formate intermediates.

pricing.note: Live Pd feed with a precursor / conversion markup.
Live Ag feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup for PdAg alloy formation.
N-doped carbon support cost held on engineering proxy until a clean public bulk price is curated.

candidates.title: Single-atom Ru on Mg-Al LDH
candidates.summary: Isolated ruthenium sites grafted on a hydrotalcite surface hydrogenate CO2 to formate at 100 C and 2 MPa in base - the recyclable solid alternative to the homogeneous pincer systems.
decision_notes: Closes the solid-catalyst gap next to two pincer complexes and a PdAg alloy; separation economics favor it over homogeneous routes.
Ru loading screened at 0.5 wt%: single-site loadings are low by construction and the abstract states no weight figure.

pricing.note: Live Ru feed with an elevated markup for the grafting-precursor route; loading is a screening assumption.
Synthetic hydrotalcite proxy, floored by the UN Comtrade magnesia ($0.52/kg) and calcined-alumina ($0.60/kg) unit values; no public hydrotalcite quote was verified.
